## 🎯 Goals & Preferences

**North-star / brand angle.** **Documentary-style client stories** are the documented centre of the CASS content programme, drawn from the 600+ shelter-occupant population that this file calls "powerful documentary content opportunities." Reference orgs named for style: **Atlanta Rescue Mission, LA Rescue Mission**. ON-TRACK = a real resident telling their own story in their own words, with dignity, landing on forward motion (stability, the next chapter) rather than on hardship alone. OFF-TRACK = a hardship montage with no person at the centre, or an org-promo with no human story.

**Formats in play:** short-form social (TikTok-focused, 60-second Q&A), event coverage (Beds & Breakfast), seasonal campaign content (heat advisory / Thirst Responders), documentary client stories.

**Preferences / hard rules captured so far:**
- **Staff interviews (current, Zsirai 31 Aug):** 2-3 minutes (3 is the goal), vertical, for Reels and Shorts. Zsirai's interview questions go in before each answer. Shelter-specific b-roll is optional, never forced. Exception: Bri's cut has the questions taken out (Zsirai, 17 Sep).
- **B-roll rule:** dinner b-roll stays out of staff videos and the Vista Colina Evergreen. Downtown-shelter b-roll is fine in Janet, Lucinda and Brittnie. Card hand-out b-roll only in Brittnie's.
- **Bri** is spelled BRI on screen (not Brie, not Bree).
- **Dual format:** CASS can get a horizontal and a vertical edit of a video (Nick, 21 Apr).
- **CEO on camera needs good lighting** - explicitly noted; check any CEO appearance for it.
- **Photography is in-house (Zsirai)** - HP delivers video; do not flag missing stills as a gap.
- **Naming:** "Central Arizona Shelter Services" in full, "CASS" as the acronym; programme names per the glossary above (Vista Colina Family Shelter, Thirst Responders, Beds & Breakfast, Inside CASS, On Jackson). CTA domain is **cassaz.org**.

## Organization Overview
Founded in 1984, Central Arizona Shelter Services (CASS) is the home of Arizona's first senior emergency shelter program, serving individuals and families experiencing homelessness across the Phoenix metropolitan area. They operate approximately 600+ shelter beds across multiple locations. Their mission: "Prevent and end homelessness among individuals and families while advancing compassionate community solutions."

**Website**: cassaz.org
**Values**: Accessibility, compassion, dignity, equity, housing-first
**Social**: IG @cass_az | FB Central Arizona Shelter Services | YT @cass_az

## Key Contacts
